name: COFFEA CRUDA
key_symptoms: Excessive hunger. Intolerance of tight clothing. After wine and liquor.
Tight pain, worse from noise, smell, narcotics. Seems as if brain were torn to pieces, as if nail were driven in head. Worse in open air. Sensitive hearing.
Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children.
Violent irregular palpitation especially after excessive joy or surprise. Rapid high tension pulse and urinary suppression.
Crural neuralgia; worse, motion, afternoon and night; better, by pressure.

worse: excessive emotions (joy), narcotics, strong odors, noise, open air, cold, night

mind_symptoms: Gaiety, easy comprehension, irritability, excited; senses acute. Impressionable, especially to pleasurable impressions. Full of ideas, quick to act. Tossing about in anguish (Acon).
head_symptoms: Tight pain, worse from noise, smell, narcotics. Seems as if brain were torn to pieces, as if nail were driven in head. Worse in open air. Sensitive hearing.
respiratory_symptoms: Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children.
gi_symptoms: Excessive hunger. Intolerance of tight clothing. After wine and liquor.
urinary_symptoms: Menses too early and long lasting. Dysmenorrhśa, large clots of black blood. Hypersensitive vulva and vagina. Voluptuous itching.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Crural neuralgia; worse, motion, afternoon and night; better, by pressure.
sleep_symptoms: Wakeful; on a constant move. Sleeps till 3 am, after which only dozing. Wakes with a start, sleep disturbed by dreams. Sleepless, on account mental activity; flow of ideas, with nervous excitability. Disturbed by itching of anus.
